entries.name: Bat

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 18 named the Ultimate Animated Animals bat (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked). Two reachable Quaternius CC0 bats were tried. The 2018 Animated Monster Pack bat (https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-animated-monsters) has the stronger bat silhouette, but its eyes hang on a second armature held to the Face bone by a Child Of constraint; with two armatures Blender's glTF exporter writes no actions, and dropping the eye rig leaves the eyes on the floor, so it cannot ship without a pipeline change. This chibi bat from the 2020 Cute Monster Pack comes through whole: a round head-body with bat ears, small wings and fangs. Height 0.2 m puts its wingspan at about 0.37 m, the span of a mid-size real bat (a noctule's is 0.32-0.40 m); the body is chibi-large for that span. The pack has no idle: a bat hovers, so idle and fly both play the Flying flap loop. Ground: Flying only bobs up from its rest low point (0 to 15 mm), so it never sinks and needs no lift (a film raises the bat to its flight height); Death rolls onto its back and sank 10 mm, so it is clamped. Every grey of the painted fur maps to one fur role: the ear-interior greys are speckled across the body too and only added noise.
